How deep is the ocean, really?
Its deepest point is the Challenger Deep, in the Mariana Trench.
but how deep is that, really?
Its peak would still be more than two kilometers underwater.
Down there, the water pressure is over a thousand times stronger than at the surface.
Like eight tons pressing on every square inch.
Has anyone actually been down there?
In 1960, two men, Jacques Piccard and Don Walsh, sank down in a sub called the Trieste.
On the way, a window cracked...
It took almost five hours to reach the bottom.
Tiny shrimp-like creatures crawl across the bottom.
And in 2019, an explorer at the very bottom found something else...
